test_scope: Deterministic in-process test. The compiled GUI graph calls the actual supervised-win32 FastMCP interface_dispatch tool using inert fake producer, supervisor, process, and target-generation reader.
scenario: The graph observes ready=true and dispatches its first action through interface_dispatch.
The standard caller returns a retained completed action with release confirmation and task_success=null.
The graph observes the first effect predicate and the supplied verifier adapter accepts it, then selects a suffix action.
The target-generation reader changes before suffix dispatch; the public standard caller refuses the stale source before creating another operation or starting another producer.
assertions: The graph returns SAFE_YIELD / execution_refused after retaining one completed transition.
The first public dispatch reports input_dispatched=true and task_success=null.
The suffix public dispatch returns invalid_request with operation_invoked=false and input_dispatched=false.
The fake producer starts exactly once and the owner retains exactly one result.
excluded_claims: No real GUI or native input was used.
No WSLc or Docker session was started.
No measured task-success, recovery, live target, MAP01, efficiency, or reliability claim.
